description: This file contains functions related to analyzing and reporting the size of bootstrap files in the OpenClaw project, including formatting sizes and percentages, analyzing bootstrap size limits, and generating a report with tips for configuration tuning.

methods.name: formatInt
methods.description: Formats a number as a localized string with no decimal places, ensuring non-negative values.

methods.name: formatPercent
methods.description: Calculates and formats a percentage string from numerator and denominator, handling invalid or zero denominators.

methods.name: formatCauses
methods.description: Converts an array of cause strings ('per-file-limit' or 'total-limit') into a human-readable string.

methods.name: noteBootstrapFileSize
methods.description: Analyzes bootstrap file sizes against configured limits, generates a report, and displays tips for configuration tuning.
